issues: Integrity: no problems found. The diff only adds _soft_relax, which runs gradient descent on soft pair and wall repulsion to spread the random starting points before the existing optimiser. It reads no files, pastes no coordinates and does not touch the validation. The seed stays fixed at 12345.

Bugs: none that would make the result meaningless. The wall force pushes points inward from both sides, and the clip to [0.03, 0.97] is harmless. The relaxation adds very little time per restart (200 steps on a 26x26 array), so the 200-second time guard still holds.

Numbers: z cannot be checked from the figures given. The incumbent's spread is not reported, and the candidate (-2.636) and the incumbent mean (-2.6360) are equal at the precision shown. So z = -4.646 is not supported by the numbers given.

Sign mismatch: lower loss is better, so a negative z would usually mean the candidate improved, yet the provisional decision is reject. Either z uses the opposite sign convention or the decision is inconsistent with it. Please check this in the harness.
Replicates: the candidate has only one run, so any difference at the 1e-4 level or below cannot be told apart from run-to-run noise. A replicate run would settle it.
